ambiguities.sections: §5.3 row 2 and its 边界; §6.2 可选; §6.3 step 1
ambiguities.readings: (a) keep=false under §5.3 row 2, since §6.3 step 1 says anything in §5.3 is 不收; (b) keep=true at weight optional, since the row's boundary and §6.2 say stock moves, market cap and multiples are 可选. I chose (b); a yes/no keep cannot carry '提示词不要求留，评估可选'.
Market data (prices, multiples) and ecosystem counts fit no kind cleanly: kind 3 (a claim about the company) or kind 1/2 (a published number) or no kind; I used 3 for market data.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 row 8 (模板) versus the prompt's 'not a statement'
ambiguities.readings: Ads and unrelated headlines are listed inside the 模板 row ('广告、页面上和本文无关的内容'), so they could be reject_row 模板 or 'not a statement'; I used 'not a statement' for off-article page items and 模板 for boilerplate inside the article (S29, B11).

ambiguities.sections: §5.1 '标题里的说法和正文是同一条，不单记'; §5.3
ambiguities.readings: A headline is not a separate record yet is on no §5.3 row: keep=true with the body record's classification, or keep=false as not a separate record. I chose keep=true.
A sentence giving one term of a larger event can take the event record's weight (T30 core like S40) or be weighed on its own information (T30 supporting: a term without amount).

The rule puts a company or its management speaking about itself in kind 1, but kind 3's example is 'CFO 说十年前建的工厂仍满负荷'; a supplier's view of its own market (B06) is kind 3 by the rule, so a CEO's price forecast (Y09) can be kind 1 or 3.

Step 2 calls '宣布了一个计划' a fact, step 3 calls '当事方说自己将来要做什么' a party statement; an announced future action ('will deploy', 'will raise prices 8% from September', 'aims to raise debt', 'is planned at up to') fits both.
An opinion from unnamed 'analysts cited by Bloomberg' is rumour by step 1 (source not named) or third-party view by step 4 (an estimate or judgment, not a reported fact).

A third party's or an unconfirmed report's claim of a certain state (scrapped, delayed to 2028, has started guarantees) is core because §6.4 says tier does not decide weight, or supporting because the state itself is not confirmed; D215 #10 names the category but not the weight.

ambiguities.sections: §6.2 可选 '已知事实在后来文章里的重述'; §10 B10; §6.3
ambiguities.readings: Earlier results restated in a later article (Q1 revenue reported in May) are optional as a restatement, or core by §6.3 (revenue with an amount); §10 B10 says extraction cannot know what is 'known', so gold and model may differ.

ambiguities.sections: 待拍 1; §6.2 核心 '金额或确定状态' versus 辅助 '有名有姓但缺金额'
ambiguities.readings: A signed or launched deal without a value has a certain state (core by '金额或确定状态'), but 待拍 1 and the supporting row say named actions missing an amount are supporting. I chose supporting.

ambiguities.sections: §6.2 关键判断 list; §1 seven drivers
ambiguities.readings: Competition is a driver but not in the key-judgment list (收入、利润、融资或信用风险、需求、关键产品进度、关键投入); a competitor's certain, sized action (a rival drug approved, 120 stores opened) is core as hitting revenue or demand, or supporting as a general driver.

ambiguities.sections: §6.2 '对这家公司的规模来说不是小事'
ambiguities.readings: No threshold for 'not small': Firmus's 170,000-GPU, 360 MW plan is core (amount, large) or supporting (Sharon's 72 MW contract was judged supporting, D215 #9); a $300 million impairment depends on an unstated company size.

Sharon's $4.88 billion backstop is a sized NVIDIA obligation (core by definition), but Alex judged the Sharon item supporting ('辅助属于供给需求'); it is unclear whether D215 #9 covers the backstop or only the 72 MW contract.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 row 2 versus row 3; row 4 边界 (条件估值)
ambiguities.readings: Row 3 rejects another company's valuation only when 'unrelated to all the company's markets', but Micron is a supplier and Microsoft a customer, so row 2 (optional) could apply instead; S33 is a derived conditional valuation that row 4's boundary keeps, unclear whether only for the covered company; T10 does not say which stock it means.

待拍 3 covers the company's own ecosystem numbers; a partner's downloads (S38) or conference attendance (Y11) are optional by analogy, or rejected under the first layer as routine business that touches no driver.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 row 7 (只有形容的引语) versus §5.2 and D240
ambiguities.readings: 'Loan growth would be solid' is an adjective-only quote (reject) or directional guidance on a key metric kept at lower weight (supporting).

The note makes the Singapore case's overview and defendants' assets optional; a US probe into DeepSeek in the same article is either part of that optional case or a kind 4 policy step kept as supporting.

ambiguities.sections: §5.3 rows 4-5 versus §6.3 step 2 (市场预期 → 可选)
ambiguities.readings: Commentary on market reaction or investor sentiment is rejected as framing or an unargued conclusion, or kept as optional market-expectation information.
A recall and an impairment fit none of the seven drivers cleanly (product cycle or supply/capacity); a regulator's approval fits both 产品周期 ('获批') and 政策 ('监管决定').
The statement names no company, so whose key judgment it touches is unstated; core if read for a bank (rates) or a handset or chip maker (shipments), undetermined otherwise.

Published industry data is a 'published number' (fact), but step 2 limits speakers to the party, a counterparty, an official record or media relaying them; a data firm is a named third party (third-party view).
A company reporting its supplier's price rise is kind 1 (the company speaking) or kind 2 (the supplier's action).
An anonymous report of a government decision is kind 4 (the content is a policy decision) or kind 3 (an unnamed party's claim).

TIKR reporting Rubin's production status may be a relay of the company's own status (kind 1, fact by step 2) or a third party's report (kind 3, third-party view); the text does not say whose statement TIKR relays.
A journalist's hedged guess about a gaming refresh or memory supply is weak evidence kept as supporting, or an unargued conclusion rejected.

ambiguities.sections: §6.2 可选 (孤零零的目标价, 待拍 4) versus 辅助 (条件估值)
ambiguities.readings: A price target justified only by a multiple times EPS is a lone target (optional) or a derived conditional valuation (supporting); the standard does not say how much derivation is needed.
'Declined to comment on reports' adds nothing from the company; the record is either the underlying rumour (kept, supporting) or nothing to keep.

ambiguities.sections: §3.1 A (分部撑起几乎全部业务); §4.2 test 4; §4.4
ambiguities.readings: Total revenue when data center carries nearly all of it is either opened but rewritten to the segment (Q14) or not opened as the same debate as the segment question (Q19 same as Q01); with no data-center question open (Q14) the standard does not say whether to open as written, rewrite, or refuse.
A theme policy question passes 值得追 if judged for the world at large, and fails if judged against the covered universe (no covered company moves on a lidar bill).

A macro or industry quantity opens from a company article, but from a pure macro article only if the theme is on the coverage list; the case does not say which kind of article it came from or whether the theme is listed.
A non-covered foundry's price rise is its own action (not opened, evidence) or an input price several chipmakers move on (a shared quantity, if written as a quantity rather than a yes/no event).
For an airline fuel is a primary value driver, so fuel cost per seat mile could be the main-driver question; or it is one cost line of guidance (费用率), not opened.
No article date is given for the P questions; FY2027 ARR is allowed if it is this or next fiscal year and refused if later.

ambiguities.sections: §4.3 last row versus §4.3 '同一个量的另一个估计、另一种口径' and §4.4
ambiguities.readings: Alphabet's capex is both a non-covered company's own quantity and a component of the open five-hyperscaler total; either row gives 'not open', but the two rows route the evidence differently.
